results.content: Concretely, this moves AI beyond “is this patient at risk of X?” to “what is this person’s likely health trajectory over many years?” For example: a 55-year-old whose disease trajectory shows elevated cancer risk could be targeted for early screening, even if he doesn't meet age-based cancer screening guidelines.
